messages:
Samira Ali: Alert  Customer NovaMed (NM-214) reported their scheduled bulk activation failed at 03:12 UTC. They have a renewal conversation in ~5 weeks. Need a short customer status + office hours.
Theo Grant: paste the top errors pls
Samira Ali: logs: `ingest-controller: upstream 502` and `shard warm timeout` repeated.
Renee Cho: preliminary: continuous batching + slow cache warm on their shard caused retries to queue. Eng please confirm.
Theo Grant: confirmed. Plan: (1) disable continuous batching for NM-214 (2) increase cache warm concurrency (3) replay failed chunks at smaller size. Steps 1+2 in ~30m, replay ~2h.
InfraBot: Incident NM-214-2026 created, priority=P2.
Samira Ali: Renee, can you draft a 3-line customer note with ETA and two office hour slots?
Renee Cho: Draft -> "Hi NovaMed  were aware of partial activation failures earlier today. Root cause: cache warm/backpressure during a large import. What were doing: disabling tenant batching (ETA ~30m), warming your shard and replaying failed items (ETA ~2.5h). Were scheduling office hours Wed 08:00 PT or Wed 16:00 CET and will apply a temporary credit. Reply with preferred slot and any priority seat IDs. Apologies  Renee on behalf of Redwood Support"
Theo Grant: edit: add safety note `we will dedupe writes and rate-limit replays to avoid duplicates` and send.
CSM - Marco: Sent to NovaMed (ticket #90100). Customer replied: "Prefer Wed 08:00 PT. Priority seats: 420, 421."
Samira Ali: Actions: @Theo disable batching + cache change. @Marco send invite and track renewal owner. @Renee prepare exec blurb. RCA draft due 72h, customer-friendly summary 8h, credits within 24h.
Theo Grant: Change applied: batching disabled for NM-214 at 1765432500. Cache warm started.
Theo Grant: Replay started; activations climbing from ~55% -> ~90% after first tranche. Will update +60m.
Samira Ali: Keeping this thread as single source for external updates. React when seen. :white_check_mark:
Theo Grant: :white_check_mark:
Renee Cho: :thumbsup:
